source_event.summary: Independent audit found scheme-only URL validation could propagate embedded userinfo credentials into an external message or callback.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A configurable external URL is accepted based only on scheme, so URL userinfo credentials survive parsing and are propagated into a user-facing link, callback, redirect, or provider payload.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Parse the configured URL and treat protocol=https as sufficient proof that the complete serialized URL is safe to propagate.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Reject configurable external URLs that contain username or password userinfo before any derived value is propagated; scheme validation alone is insufficient.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Exercise full credentials, username-only and encoded userinfo, assert rejection before exposure or provider outbound, and preserve a credential-free HTTPS positive control.

transfer_cases.scenario: credential-bearing base URL is rejected while a clean HTTPS base produces a sanitized action link
credential-bearing callback base degrades safely with zero outbound while a clean HTTPS callback remains configured

skill_changes.change: Added generic URL userinfo rejection rule and URL-USERINFO-SECRET-001.
Added full-credentials, username-only, encoded-userinfo, secret-body and zero-outbound adversarial dimensions.
Added generic contract coverage for prevention and detection assets.
